t: Building a Plugin-Ready Framework: A Step-by-Step Transformation
s: The article details a process for transforming a system into a plugin-ready framework by abstracting common patterns into a `BaseApp` class, enabling dynamic registration, and refactoring existing applications for modularity and ease of updates.
sub: Abstracting common functionality into a `BaseApp` class
Dynamic route registration for seamless app integration
Refactoring existing apps (TodoApp, ProfileApp) to inherit from `BaseApp`
Leveraging Nix Flakes and Python for a portable tech stack
